snippet.title: Matchbox CATERPILLAR Big Dirt Movers - Beach Zone
snippet.description: A sand castle is on the verge of collapsing due to the high tide. A dump truck is needed to deliver some dirt near the shores and use the bulldozer to flatten the dirt, thus keeping the waves from hitting the castle. But be quick, the castle's side (nearest to the water) will soon collapse if you don't make it in time.
